name: Liznr
description:
Liznr is an AI meeting assistant who joins virtual calls to simplify context in real-time, summarize key points, and enhance understanding, without compromising data privacy. Ideal for professionals, teams, and enterprises.
#knowledge_management #real-time
label: World's 1st AI-secretary that helps in Meetings in Real-Time
label_zh: 世界首款实时会议助手AI秘书
content_zh: Liznr 是一款 AI 会议助手，可以加入虚拟通话，实时简化内容、总结要点并提高理解力，同时不会泄露数据隐私。它非常适合专业人士、团队和企业使用。

name: Uplyt.io
description: Uplyt makes Google Analytics & Ads easy for marketers, e-commerce owners and SMBs. Connect your data, get clear KPIs, smart alerts, and AI-powered insights to boost your traffic & conversions. No analytics expertise needed.
label: Smarter Google Analytics, better website performance
label_zh: 更智能的 Google Analytics，更好的网站性能
content_zh: Uplyt 让 Google Analytics 和 Ads 对营销人员、电商店主和中小企业变得更加简单。连接你的数据，获取清晰的关键指标、智能提醒和由 AI 驱动的洞察，以提升你的流量和转化率。无需具备数据分析的专业知识。

name: Tipsy Chat: Your AI Tavern
description: Tipsy Chat is reimagining AI roleplay—where you’re the star, director, and writer of your own world. With real-time image and video generation, stories feel alive, characters evolve, and every message shapes the journey. Create, connect, and escape—your way.
label: Live Your Story—1st AI Image & Video Roleplay World
label_zh:
直译：
活出你的故事——首个AI图像与视频角色扮演世界

意译：
活出你的故事——首个AI图像与视频角色扮演天地
content_zh: Tipsy Chat 重新定义了 AI 角色扮演——在这里，你既是主角，又是导演和编剧，创造属于自己的世界。实时生成图像和视频，让故事更加生动，角色不断进化，每条消息都在塑造旅程。你可以随心所欲地创作、连接和逃离现实。

name: SlidesCraft
description: Generic AI presentations losing your message? SlidesCraft + Claude 4 crafts precise HTML presentations, one focused slide at a time. 24 styles, deep customization. True precision. Lasting impact. Time saved.
label: Claude 4 HTML Slides: One Perfect Slide at a Time
label_zh: Claude 4 HTML幻灯片：一次只做一张完美的幻灯片
content_zh: 通用的AI演示文稿总是让你的信息丢失？SlidesCraft加上Claude 4可以帮你制作精确的HTML演示文稿，一次专注一个幻灯片。24种样式，深度定制。真正的精准，持久的影响，节省时间。

name: Shotomatic
description: Tired of capturing hundreds of screenshots by hand? Shotomatic is a blazingly-fast way to automate it all —  set a desired interval, simulate a keypress between each screenshot, capture entire screen / specific window / custom area.
label: Hands-free screenshot automation for macos
label_zh: 免提截图自动化工具，适用于 macOS
content_zh: 厌倦了手动截取大量屏幕截图吗？Shotomatic 是一种超快速的自动化工具——设置所需的时间间隔，每次截图之间模拟按键操作，可以截取整个屏幕、特定窗口或自定义区域。

name: Psyche
description: PSYCHE is a conversational AI that supports you in finding your authentic path by providing holistic support and a safe space where you can share, heal, and grow.
label: Holistic approach to your psyche
content_zh: Psyche 是一款对话式 AI，它通过提供全面的支持和一个安全的空间，帮助你找到真正适合自己的道路，在这里你可以分享、疗愈和成长。

name: Magentic-UI
description: Magentic-UI by Microsoft Research is an open-source human-centered web agent. Collaboratively plan & execute web tasks with AI, featuring co-planning, action guards & plan learning. Built on AutoGen.
label: Automate your web tasks while you stay in control
label_zh: 自动化您的网络任务，同时保持掌控
content_zh: Magentic-UI 是微软研究院开发的一个开源、以用户为中心的网页代理工具。它能够与 AI 协同规划和执行网页任务，具备共同规划、行为保护和计划学习等功能。该工具基于 AutoGen 构建。

name: vibecheck
description: designed to help you meet people you ~actually~ vibe with.  answer personality questions to discover your vibe, swipe to meet new friends who match your vibe, and chat with your new friends to connect and build new friendships!
label: Take a quiz to build your personality & match w/ people
label_zh: 参加一个测验来构建你的个性并与他人匹配
content_zh: vibecheck 旨在帮助你找到真正合得来的人。回答一些性格问题来发现你的个性，滑动屏幕来匹配与你个性相符的新朋友，然后与他们聊天，建立新的友谊！

name: Is This Course Legit?
description:
We are on a mission to make online courses scam-free.
We review and rate courses based on real data: content depth, refund policies, instructor credibility, and actual student results.
No fluff. No hype. No paid rankings.
Help us clean up the mess 💪
label: We rate and rank online courses so you don’t waste your 💰.
label_zh: 我们对在线课程进行评级和排名，以免你浪费💰。
content_zh:
我们的目标是让在线课程远离骗局。
我们根据真实数据来评估和评分课程：内容深度、退款政策、讲师可信度以及实际学生的学习成果。
没有废话，没有炒作，没有付费排名。
帮助我们一起清理这个乱象 💪

name: Paperguide Article GPT
description: Generate publication-ready articles in minutes for Free. Paperguide Article GPT scours millions of papers, cites every claim, and hands you a clean, fact-checked draft. Ideal for bloggers, academics, and marketers who need evidence-based content—fast.
label: Write research-backed articles with citations
label_zh: 撰写有研究支持并带有引用的文章
topics_zh: 写作，市场营销，人工智能
content_zh: 几分钟内免费生成可用于发布的文章。Paperguide Article GPT 会搜索数百万篇论文，为每个论点提供引用，并为你提供一份干净、经过事实核查的草稿。非常适合需要快速获取基于证据内容的博主、学者和营销人员。

name: Silver Pennies
description: Track your finances effortlessly with Silver Pennies for free! An AI agent that reads only your Transaction Alerts label in Gmail to privately track your credits, debits, and surface meaningful financial insights—no bank logins, no spreadsheets. Just clarity.
label: Your personal finance AI agent that helps you save money
label_zh: 你的个人财务AI助手，帮你省钱
content_zh: 轻松管理财务，免费使用Silver Pennies！这个AI助手只读取你Gmail中的交易提醒标签，私密地跟踪你的收入和支出，并提供有价值的财务分析——无需银行登录，无需电子表格。一切清晰明了。

name: EddyOwl
description: EddyOwl is an AI-powered platform that automates the grading of handwritten assessments, providing instant feedback and detailed analytics to streamline the evaluation process for educators.
label: Empowering Educators with AI-Driven Grading and Analytics
label_zh: 赋能教育者，提供AI驱动的评分和分析功能
content_zh: EddyOwl 是一个由 AI 驱动的平台，能够自动批改手写作业，并为教师提供即时反馈和详细分析，从而简化评估过程。

name: Plannex
description: Plannex.io is a flexible planning platform combining node-based brainstorming, task management, and workflow building, all in one place. No clutter, no extra tools. One membership, all features. Built by builders, for builders.
label: Brainstorm. Build logic. Manage tasks.
label_zh: 头脑风暴。构建逻辑。管理任务。
topics_zh: 任务管理，开发者工具，生产力
content_zh: Plannex.io 是一个灵活的规划平台，集成了基于节点的头脑风暴、任务管理和工作流构建功能。无需额外工具，一个会员账号即可享受所有功能。这个平台由开发者为开发者打造。

name: Lily Pad
description: Lily Pad is a premium aluminum split keyboard built for the Lily58 layout whether you're upgrading an existing build or starting fresh, Lily Pad makes it easy to go premium without the learning curve.
label: A premium split keyboard
content_zh: Lily Pad 是一款专为 Lily58 布局设计的高端铝合金分体键盘。无论你是升级现有的设备还是从头开始，Lily Pad 都能让你轻松享受高端体验，无需额外的学习成本。

name: MCP Fabric
description: MCP Fabric seamlessly integrates your existing APIs with LLMs, providing instant context and capabilities — no coding required.
label: Effortlessly Connect AI Agents to APIs
content_zh: MCP Fabric 无缝集成您现有的 API 和大语言模型，即时提供上下文和功能，无需编写代码。
